content: Token Jaccard is the standard cheap lexical-overlap measure for synthetic-query contamination checks; 0.60 is a permissive budget that rejects near-verbatim reuse while allowing shared topic words. Contamination literature uses Jaccard/MinHash thresholds around 0.7 for duplicate detection (BridgeAlign), and paraphrased-query work targets much lower content-word overlap (~0.21 in localGPT). For SIF the budget must be applied per leg: an exact-term title leg is trivially 1.0 and is exempt/reported as its own category, while the body leg enforces <=0.60 against title + opening text.
